profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at WellSky
profile.summary: Working professionally as a software engineer since 2018, I've grown to have a passion for language theory and back-end engineering. Before graduating with a B.S. in Computer Science from Kansas State University, I had a long history in health systems engineering as a full stack developer while also working in embedded systems. Shortly before graduation, I began my journey into Web3 as a Rust developer for Composable Finance. Since then, I have been continuing to grow as an engineer and move into seniority in the Web3 industry.
